title: [Feature request] add predefined profiles modifications
symptom: User frequently modifies profile percentage before lunch for 30 or 60 minutes, and requests predefined profile modifications similar to temporary targets.
fix: User is directed to change the hard limit by finding 'const val MAX = 130.0' in file InputPercent.kt and modifying it to their max limit.
